gaps.s: A small quick sketch to test a layout is a ___.
A small model for a 3D piece is called a ___.
The cycle is explore, experiment, review, refine and ___.
Look critically at your work to judge it: you ___ it.
AO2 is worth ___ marks out of 72 in each component.
Ideas that are settled on too soon are consolidated too ___.
Change only one ___ at a time in an experiment.
Materials should be appropriate to your personal ___.

short.q: Give two things to experiment with when developing a composition.
short.model: Viewpoint and crop (also scale, colour, symmetry or focal point).

short.q: Write a short review of an experiment where charcoal smudged too much.
short.model: The smudging lost the fine detail; next time I will use harder charcoal pencil and fix each layer.

short.q: Why are failed experiments useful for AO2?
short.model: They show you reviewed, understood why something didn't work and used that insight to refine your work.

short.q: Describe the steps from thumbnail to final plan.
short.model: Draw several thumbnails, choose two, make larger composition and colour studies, test materials, then make an annotated plan.

short.q: How would you explain a choice of materials?
short.model: Say why they suit your theme and mood, e.g. soft watercolour for a fragile, nostalgic feeling.
